name: Manteclaw Agent Services (Solana)
description: 199 pay-per-call Solana data APIs: chain state, SPL tokens, wallets, transactions, DEX pairs, DeFi, Pyth oracle feeds, pump.fun memecoins, stablecoins, markets, NFTs and utilities. Paid in USDC on Solana via x402.
